source.source_title: Amendment of the General Code of Conduct for Authorised FSPs and Representatives, 2020

locator.quote: A provider must establish and maintain an adequate complaints management framework.

source_gate.gate_reason: The source pack permits amendment-specific candidate obligations when the staged commencement table and human review are preserved.

classification.classification_rationale: The amendment is an in-force Gazette notice. The example uses a provision subject to the notice's staged commencement control and remains a candidate until reviewed.

trigger_conditions: the institution renders regulated financial services as an authorised provider

timing.value: while the regulated activity is performed

exceptions_and_dependencies: provision-level commencement must be confirmed from the notice's staged commencement table
the synthetic institution's assumed licence and activity scope require human confirmation
evidence_or_reporting_requirements: operating records showing that the framework is maintained
obligation.atomic_summary: An authorised provider must establish and maintain an adequate complaints management framework.
interpretation_notes: The record does not conclude that the framework is adequate or operating effectively.
The evidence items are candidate assurance needs and do not extend the source obligation.

assumptions: The synthetic institution is treated as an authorised provider for evaluation only.
applicability.rationale: The synthetic profile includes advice and complaints handling and expressly assumes the relevant FSCA permissions, making applicability suitable for a candidate record rather than a legal conclusion.

change.change_summary: Government Notice 706 of 2020 inserted a structured complaints-management framework into the General Code amendment chain.

operating_impact.rationale: The candidate obligation concerns the design and maintenance of the complaints framework and related customer-outcomes oversight.

limitations: This is a synthetic applicability assessment.
The complete current General Code amendment chain has not been represented as a consolidated source.
A qualified reviewer must confirm provision-level commencement and applicability.
assessment.next_action: Route to the Head of Compliance and Conduct Risk Officer for source, commencement and applicability approval.
